newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere down on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere down on higher turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares fell slightly on higher turnover on Tuesday on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE).
A shares fell to $114 from Monday's $114.50 and B shares fell to $117.625 from $117.75.
Turnover in Solidere shares rose to 8,273 from 4,685 on Monday and value was $955,611.5.
There was no trade in the four other companies listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.08 percent to 84.57 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.21 percent to 984.38.
